## The Problem Amazon Sellers Face

### Time Zone Gap
Customers ask questions at 2 PM Pacific Time. Support teams in China or the Philippines are asleep. By the time they reply, 12 hours have passed and the customer is already angry.

### Rising Labor Costs
Hiring one customer service agent costs $1,500-2,500 per month. Two agents to cover time zones doubles that cost. They still won't reply at 3 AM or handle 50 concurrent chats.

### WISMO Flood
"Where Is My Order?" — 60-70% of all buyer messages ask this question. It's repetitive, draining, and takes time away from handling real issues like returns, defects, and complex complaints.

## The Solution: AI Customer Service Agent

Tianyuan Chen deploys an AI customer service agent on the client's own server using open-source technology:

1. **Share Your Knowledge**: Client provides product docs, FAQs, return policies, and past customer conversations. A knowledge base is built tailored to the client's specific products.

2. **Deploy on Your Server**: The open-source AI stack (Dify + DeepSeek) is deployed on the client's own server in under 30 minutes. The client owns everything — code, data, and AI.

3. **AI Handles 80% of Messages**: The AI agent auto-replies to WISMO, product questions, return policy inquiries, and more. Complex issues get flagged for human review.

## Real Results (Measured)

- Response Time: 6 hours → under 30 seconds (720x faster)
- First-Reply Within 1 Hour: 12% → 99.7%
- Support Team Size: 2 full-time agents → 0.5 part-time reviewer (75% reduction)
- Monthly Labor Cost: $2,400 (2 agents) → $199 (Pro plan) or 92% cost reduction
- Coverage Hours: 8 hours/day → 24/7/365 (3x coverage)
- WISMO Auto-Resolution: 0% → 80%
- Customer Satisfaction: 3.8/5 → 4.6/5 (+21%)

## Tech Stack

### Dify (RAG Engine)
Open-source LLM app platform with 60,000+ GitHub stars. Powers retrieval-augmented generation so AI only answers based on actual product knowledge, not hallucinations.
URL: https://github.com/langgenius/dify

### DeepSeek (Large Language Model)
State-of-the-art LLM with native multilingual capability. Performs at GPT-4 level on customer service tasks at less than 5% of the API cost.
URL: https://deepseek.com

### Docker (Deployment)
Containerized deployment on the client's server — AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or on-premise. Client's infrastructure, client's control. No data ever leaves the client's environment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does the AI customer service agent work for my Amazon store?
The AI agent is deployed on the client's own server using open-source Dify RAG framework and DeepSeek LLM. It learns from product documentation, past customer conversations, and returns policy. When a buyer sends a message, the AI retrieves the most relevant knowledge, generates an accurate response, and sends it — all in under 30 seconds, 24/7, in 12 languages.

### What is the cost compared to hiring customer service agents?
The Starter plan is $99/month plus a one-time $299 setup fee. A single outsourced customer service agent costs $800-1,500/month. The Growth plan at $199/month replaces 2 full-time agents and delivers 24/7 coverage — saving over 90% in labor costs.

### Where is customer data stored? Who owns it?
All data is stored on the client's own server. Nothing goes to any cloud. The code is open-source (Dify on GitHub with 60,000+ stars), fully auditable. If the client stops working with Tianyuan Chen, the system keeps running — there is no vendor lock-in.

### Which languages does the AI agent support?
The agent supports 12 languages natively: English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Korean, Arabic, and Russian. It auto-detects the customer's language and responds in the same language.

### How long does it take to set up?
From signing up to having the AI agent responding to customers, it takes 3-5 business days. Tianyuan handles the full setup: server deployment, knowledge base construction, and accuracy testing.

### What happens during Amazon peak seasons (Prime Day, Black Friday)?
The AI agent scales automatically. Fixed monthly pricing stays the same regardless of volume. The agent handles 50 or 500 concurrent chats with no performance degradation.

### How is accuracy ensured?
The system uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), meaning the AI only answers based on actual product data and policies — not generic knowledge. Weekly accuracy audits and continuous knowledge base optimization based on real conversation data.
